title: Sousou no Frieren
synopsis: During their decade-long quest to defeat the Demon King, the members of the hero's party forge bonds through adventures and battles. As the years pass, Frieren gradually realizes how her days in the hero's party truly impacted her.

title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
synopsis: After a horrific alchemy experiment goes wrong, brothers Edward and Alphonse Elric set off on a quest to restore their bodies by locating the Philosopher's Stone.

title: Steins;Gate
synopsis: Eccentric scientist Rintarou Okabe discovers his invention can send messages into the past, leading him into a dangerous battle to protect his loved ones and preserve the timeline.

title: Hunter x Hunter (2011)
synopsis: Gon Freecss aims to become a Hunter to find his father, befriending Kurapika, Leorio, and Killua as they venture into a perilous world together.

title: Gintama
synopsis: In an alternate Edo ruled by aliens, Gintoki Sakata and his Yorozuya team take on odd jobs, encountering everything from alien royalty to local gang scuffles.
